comment: Governance maturity is described developmentally but without a mechanism for revising the arrangement itself. The most significant governance risk over the life of a health infrastructure is not immaturity but purpose expansion: capabilities built for care become available for research, oversight, enforcement or entitlement decisions, incrementally and by administrative decision.

public.text: Governance maturity is described developmentally but without a mechanism for revising the arrangement itself. The most significant governance risk over the life of a health infrastructure is not immaturity but purpose expansion: capabilities built for care become available for research, oversight, enforcement or entitlement decisions, incrementally and by administrative decision.
public.suggestedRevision: Recommend that the legal instrument establishing DPI-H contain a revision clause requiring that any expansion of the purposes for which the infrastructure may be used be decided at the same level as its creation - legislative rather than administrative - with published justification. The most reliable protection against purpose creep is not technical control or supervision but the political cost of amending a law, and this is also the assurance that makes an objection-based model defensible to citizens who do not wish to participate.
